description: Learn to compare cladding, insulation, tile and building materials, with a focus on technical documentation and supplier research.
hero: Choose materials with the full picture.
intro: Explore material categories, performance questions and procurement checklists. A clearer path from project requirements to manufacturer documentation.
heroCardCopy: Fire behavior, local building codes, environmental conditions and installation systems can determine suitability.

topics.title: Performance documents
topics.summary: Review test scope, standard edition, product identity and the issuing laboratory.

topics.title: System compatibility
topics.summary: A component's performance may depend on its installed assembly.

topics.title: Procurement basics
topics.summary: Understand tolerances, packaging, shipping damage and acceptance criteria.

products.name: Porcelain floor tile
products.description: Dense ceramic tile commonly specified for floors and interior finishes.
products.spec: Dimensions, water absorption, slip performance, shade and caliber.
products.caution: Check slip requirements, installation substrate and project conditions.

products.name: Aluminum profile
products.description: Extruded profiles used in framing, interiors and building envelopes.
products.spec: Alloy/temper, cross-section, finish, tolerance, coating specification.
products.caution: Confirm structural suitability and traceable material certificates.

products.name: Mineral wool insulation
products.description: Fiber insulation used for thermal and acoustic applications in assemblies.
products.spec: Density, declared thermal performance, thickness, fire test context.
products.caution: System fire performance is not established by one product label.

products.name: Fiber cement board
products.description: Cement-based panel for selected facade and interior applications.
products.spec: Thickness, strength, moisture behavior, fastener system.
products.caution: Confirm dust-handling procedures and approved application.

products.name: Insulated glass unit
products.description: Factory assembled glazing panes with a sealed cavity.
products.spec: Glass build-up, cavity type, coatings, safety glass needs.
products.caution: Regional energy and safety glazing requirements may apply.

products.name: Waterproofing membrane
products.description: Sheet or liquid-applied barrier forming part of water-management systems.
products.spec: Substrate compatibility, thickness, test method, application conditions.

guides.title: Read a material test report
guides.summary: A certificate is meaningful only if it matches the product and intended application.
checks: Compare company, product name and sample identification.
Verify test method edition, result scope and document issuer.
Record any gaps against local building code requirements.

guides.title: Importing building materials
guides.summary: Physical dimensions and packing practices can change the real landed cost.
checks: Ask for weights, packaging units and damage protection.
Clarify production tolerances and replacement policy.
Define pre-shipment inspection and Incoterms in writing.

guides.title: Fire ratings need context
guides.summary: Individual material labels do not automatically establish entire assembly compliance.
checks: Identify whether the rating applies to material or tested system.
Compare the installation details with the test specimen.
Engage a competent local professional for code-sensitive use.

faq.question: Can a product certificate guarantee project approval?
faq.answer: No. Approval depends on jurisdiction, application and the full installed system.

faq.question: Does the directory list accredited factories?
faq.answer: No. Supplier onboarding is not yet open.

faq.question: Is pricing available?
faq.answer: Not currently. These are representative material types, not live catalog offers.

disclosure: All building material specifications and local-code decisions require project-specific professional verification.

zh-CN.description: 学习比较外墙材料、保温材料、瓷砖及其他建材，重点了解技术文件和供应商调研。
zh-CN.hero: 全面了解，才能选对材料。
zh-CN.intro: 了解材料分类、性能问题和采购核查清单，从项目要求逐步落实到制造商文件。
zh-CN.heroCardCopy: 燃烧性能、当地建筑规范、环境条件及安装系统都可能决定材料是否适用。

topics.title: 性能文件
topics.summary: 核查检测范围、标准版本、产品身份及出具报告的实验室。

topics.title: 系统兼容性
topics.summary: 组件的性能可能取决于其所在的安装系统。

topics.title: 采购基础
topics.summary: 了解公差、包装、运输损坏及验收标准。

products.name: 瓷质地砖
products.description: 常用于地面及室内饰面的致密陶瓷砖。
products.spec: 尺寸、吸水率、防滑性能、色号及尺寸分级。
products.caution: 核查防滑要求、安装基层及项目条件。

products.name: 铝型材
products.description: 用于框架、室内构件及建筑围护结构的挤压型材。
products.spec: 合金及状态、截面、表面处理、公差、涂层规格。
products.caution: 核实结构适用性及可追溯的材质证明。

products.name: 矿物棉保温材料
products.description: 用于构造系统中隔热和吸声用途的纤维材料。
products.spec: 密度、声明的热工性能、厚度、燃烧试验适用条件。
products.caution: 单一产品标签不能证明整个系统的防火性能。

products.name: 纤维水泥板
products.description: 用于特定外墙及室内用途的水泥基板材。
products.spec: 厚度、强度、湿度影响、紧固系统。
products.caution: 确认粉尘处理程序及获准使用的场景。

products.name: 中空玻璃组件
products.description: 在工厂组装、带密封空腔的玻璃组件。
products.spec: 玻璃构造、空腔类型、镀膜、安全玻璃要求。
products.caution: 可能需要满足当地节能及安全玻璃要求。

products.name: 防水膜材
products.description: 作为水分管理系统组成部分的片材或液态施工屏障。
products.spec: 基层兼容性、厚度、试验方法、施工条件。
products.caution: 施工方法和节点处理会影响性能。

guides.title: 读懂材料检测报告
guides.summary: 证书只有与产品及预期用途相符时才有参考意义。
checks: 核对企业、产品名称及样品标识。
核实试验方法版本、结果适用范围及文件出具方。
记录与当地建筑规范要求之间的差距。

guides.title: 进口建筑材料
guides.summary: 实物尺寸及包装方式可能改变实际到岸成本。
checks: 索取重量、包装单位及防损措施资料。
明确生产公差及更换政策。
以书面形式约定装运前检验及国际贸易术语。

guides.title: 理解防火等级的适用条件
guides.summary: 单项材料标签不能自动证明整个构造系统合规。
checks: 确认等级适用于材料还是经过试验的系统。
比较安装细节与试验样件是否一致。
涉及建筑规范的用途，应咨询当地具备能力的专业人员。

faq.question: 产品证书能保证项目获批吗？
faq.answer: 不能。审批取决于管辖地区、具体用途及完整的安装系统。

faq.question: 目录中是否已有经过认可的工厂？
faq.answer: 没有。供应商入驻尚未开放。

faq.question: 可以查询价格吗？
faq.answer: 目前不可以。这里展示的是代表性材料类型，并非实时报价目录。

zh-CN.disclosure: 所有建材规格及当地规范适用性判断，都需要结合具体项目进行专业核实。
